title: Language runtime load comparison — hello-json
notes: Compares a Python/FastAPI and a Node/Express hello-JSON site under one identical workload on this host. Each site runs warmup_runs (discarded) + repeat_count measured passes; the campaign reports the median across repeats. COMPARABILITY (v2): loopback targets measured with the same profile on the same machine are comparable as a single-host client-side comparison; remote client-only runs and mixed profiles are flagged not-comparable. Start each target natively with `python scripts/native_target.py <site-id> start` before running the campaign, and stop it with `stop` afterwards.
